command: Desulfovibrio vulgaris Hildenborough AprA (Q72DT2), the alpha subunit of adenylylsulfate reductase, localizes to the plasma membrane (GO:0005886). Distinguish soluble cytoplasmic enzyme from a peripheral membrane-associated pool through QmoABC binding. Evaluate direct fractionation, localization, complex and interaction evidence; membrane interaction alone may or may not establish residency. The absence of a transmembrane helix does not exclude peripheral membrane localization. Separate AprA from succinate dehydrogenase.
